毛毛虫怎样变成蝴蝶？: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?
沿着同一个生命往前走：卵、小毛毛虫、蛹、蝴蝶。点到蛹时，看看里面发生了什么。: Follow one life through egg, caterpillar, chrysalis and butterfly. At the chrysalis, peek at what is changing inside.
一起找一找：哪个阶段吃叶子？哪个阶段外面很安静，里面却在变化？: Look together: which stage eats leaves? Which looks quiet outside while changing inside?
这是蝴蝶完全变态的四阶段示意。插画不对应一种特定蝴蝶；不同种类的体形、食物和时间: This illustrates the four stages of complete metamorphosis in butterflies, not one particular species. Shapes, foods and timing vary. The transparent chrysalis is a teaching diagram, not an actual internal view; development is not a tiny finished butterfly hiding inside a shell. Stage buttons revisit observations; animals do not grow backward.
先猜一猜，再动手试一试。: Make a guess, then try it.
很多蝴蝶把卵产在适合幼虫吃的植物上。小毛毛虫会从卵里孵出来。: Many butterflies lay eggs on plants their caterpillars can eat. A tiny caterpillar hatches from an egg.
毛毛虫是蝴蝶的幼虫。它吃东西、长大，还会蜕掉旧的外皮。: A caterpillar is a butterfly larva. It eats, grows and sheds its old outer skin.
蛹不是在睡觉。外面很安静，里面的身体正在重新发育，翅膀等成虫结构逐渐形成。: A chrysalis is not sleeping. It looks quiet outside, but the body is developing inside, including wings and other adult structures.
蝴蝶从蛹里出来，翅膀展开、变硬后才能飞。成虫交配产卵，下一代又开始了。: The butterfly emerges. Its wings expand and harden before flight. Adults mate and lay eggs, starting the next generation.
只演示羽化后的展开与准备，时间经过压缩；拖动是在回看。: This shows expansion and preparation after emergence, with time compressed. Scrubbing reviews the process.
刚羽化：翅还小而皱，不能马上飞。: Just emerged: the wings are small and crumpled, not ready for flight.
体液进入翅脉，帮助柔软的翅慢慢伸展。: Body fluid enters the wing veins, helping the soft wings expand.
翅已展开，还需要逐渐硬化，才适合飞行。: The wings have expanded but still need to harden before flight.
翅膀展开用简化形变表示，不复原真实折叠几何；展开之后还需要等待翅硬化。: Wing expansion uses simplified shape changes, not exact folding geometry; the expanded wings still need time to harden.
